title.zh: 【富兰克林邓普顿向 XRP Ledger 新增约 1.5 亿美元代币化基金份额，全部集中于单一钱包】
title.en: 【富兰克林邓普顿向 XRP Ledger 新增约 1.5 亿美元代币化基金份额，全部集中于单一钱包】

current_state.zh:
据 CoinDesk 报道，富兰克林邓普顿（Franklin Templeton）向 XRP Ledger 新增约 1.5 亿美元的代币化货币市场基金份额，使该网络上的 sgBENJI 代币总量从约 4800 万枚增至 1.93 亿枚。按交易记录中每份 1.039 美元计算，总价值约 2 亿美元，且全部存放于单一钱包。

此举使该基金在 XRP Ledger 上的规模接近原来的四倍，意味着这家美国大型资产管理公司将代币化货币市场基金产品从最初的 Stellar 网络扩展到更多公链。

这些代币全部集中于单一钱包，报道提及了这一持仓结构，但未说明对应的托管方或具体客户。富兰克林邓普顿的 BENJI 是首只以公链作为登记系统的美国注册货币市场基金，sgBENJI 也被 RWA.xyz 作为代币化基金资产进行追踪。
current_state.en: Franklin Templeton added roughly $150 million in tokenized money-market fund shares to XRP Ledger, increasing sgBENJI supply there to about 193 million tokens worth approximately $200 million, all held in a single wallet.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Franklin Templeton added roughly $150 million in tokenized money-market fund shares to XRP Ledger, increasing sgBENJI supply there to about 193 million tokens worth approximately $200 million, all held in a single wallet.
updates.background_zh: 富兰克林邓普顿运营 BENJI 这一自有的区块链集成登记系统，可在公链基础设施上支持代币化共同基金份额，并通过 Benji Investments 应用提供热钱包与冷钱包环境。BENJI 最初在 Stellar 上线，2026 年 4 月该公司与 Stellar 发展基金会共同纪念该产品推出五周年。另有一项安排中，星展银行（DBS）与富兰克林邓普顿宣布在 DBS Digital Exchange 上使用 Ripple 的 RLUSD 稳定币进行 sgBENJI 的交易与借贷方案，星展银行还将探索允许 sgBENJI 作为抵押品。
updates.background_en: Franklin Templeton runs BENJI, a proprietary blockchain-integrated recordkeeping system that supports tokenized mutual fund shares on public blockchain infrastructure, including hot and cold wallet setups through its Benji Investments app. BENJI launched on Stellar, and in April 2026 the firm and the Stellar Development Foundation marked five years of the product. In a separate arrangement, DBS and Franklin Templeton announced trading and lending solutions for sgBENJI on DBS Digital Exchange using Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin, with DBS to explore accepting sgBENJI as collateral.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次增发扩大了 XRP Ledger 上的代币化国债/货币市场基金板块，而链上 RWA 规模是衡量该网络稳定币与借贷活跃度的重要变量；sgBENJI 在 DBS Digital Exchange 上已与 RLUSD 打通，并计划用于抵押，使其可能在 XRPL 的流动性与信贷场景中发挥作用，不过全部集中于单一钱包也意味着短期内流通层面的影响有限。
updates.market_impact_en: The addition expands the tokenized Treasury/money-market segment on XRP Ledger, where the size of on-chain RWA supply is a key input for stablecoin and lending activity; sgBENJI's integration with RLUSD on DBS Digital Exchange and planned collateral use give the token a potential role in XRPL-based liquidity and credit, though the single-wallet concentration limits any immediate circulation effect.
